question: Evaluate 65 ÷ 13 × 4 + (35 ÷ 7 × 9)² + 100 ÷ 5 of 4 × 80
solution:
Concept Used:

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/35805eb70ddc58d44ad978d54ed30ca44c42e6ac4a1652b0bfe52940556ba8cc.png] 

**Calculation:**

65 ÷ 13 × 4 + (35 ÷ 7 × 9)2 + 100 ÷ 5 of 4 × 80

⇒ 5 × 4 + (5 × 9)² + 100 ÷ 20 × 80

⇒ 20 + (45)² + 5 × 80

⇒ 20 + 2025 + 400

⇒ 2445
